title: Item
description: One physical thing the user wants to sell, as identified from a photo and possibly corrected by the user.

name.description: Short product name a buyer would search for, e.g. 'Apple iPad Air 2 64GB'.

condition.description: Maps to eBay condition IDs on the backend.

attributes.description: Notable features visible in the photo: capacity, colour, included accessories.

search_query.description: Keyword query to run against the eBay Browse API.

confidence.description: Model's confidence that name/brand/model are right.

notes.description: Visible flaws or uncertainty worth telling the user.
